{{Quote|Ahsoka ''trusted'' you, and you ''betrayed'' her!''"<br />"''I've learned that ''trust'' is overrated. The only thing the Jedi Council believes in is violence!|Anakin Skywalker and Barriss Offee during their fierce duel|<ref name="TWJ" />}}
A '''duel''' took place at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] confronted [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] as to her role in the [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Funny! Those belong to Ventress. You should have gotten rid of them!"<br />"I think they suit me.|Anakin Skywalker and Barriss Offee at the beginning of their duel|<ref name="TWJ" />}}
[[File:AhsokaCaught-TCAJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Ahsoka Tano in the custody of Anakin Skywalker and Plo Koon]]
After [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was framed<ref name="TJWKTM">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref> for and charged with the bombing of the Jedi Temple Hangar and the death of Letta Turmond,<ref name="TJWKTM" /> Tano decided to hide in the underworld and prove innocence on her own<ref name="TCJ" /> but was recaptured by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]<ref name="TCJ" /> and Tano was taken back to the surface where she would await trial.<ref name="TWJ" /> During the [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Trial of Ahsoka Tano]], Skywalker went into the underworld and found [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], assuming her to be the mastermind behind the recent events. Ventress pleaded innocence and revealed that someone had attacked her and stole her lightsabers after she parted ways with Ahsoka after the young [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] entered the warehouse containing the [[Nano-droid/Legends|nano-droids]] used in the bombing. The only other person to have known that she and Ahsoka went to the warehouse was [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], the one who sent them there.<ref name="TWJ" /> Skywalker returned to the Jedi Temple and found the Jedi in her [[Barriss Offee's quarters/Legends|quarters]].<ref name="TWJ" /> He questioned her and though Offee denied being in contact with Tano, Skywalker attempted to strike at her with [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber/Legends|her own lightsaber]] to prove his suspicions. Offee summoned Ventress' lightsabers, which she had kept instead of disposing, hidden in a pot to defend herself, proving that she was behind the bombing and framed Tano for her crimes. Skywalker then engaged Offee in a duel.<ref name="TWJ" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|Cease hostilities!|A Jedi Temple Guard, attempting to end the fight between Skywalker and Offee|<ref name="TWJ" />}}
[[File:TempleDuelTrainingGround-TWJ.png|thumb|250px|The duel between Skywalker and Offee spilled out into the training ground.]]
When it was revealed that Offee had framed her friend [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] for her crimes, Skywalker [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|engaged]] Offee in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] in her room. Then, Skywalker kicked her out of her room and Offee escaped into the Temple hallways and Skywalker followed. The duel continued and when Offee broke off in an attempt to escape, four [[Jedi Temple Guard/Legends|Jedi Temple Guards]] arrived, boxing Offee from the two ends of the corridor. Seeking an alternative escape route, Offee broke the Temple's windows and jumped off from the Temple. After Offee knocked Skywalker off a balcony, the duel spilled onto the [[Jedi Temple training ground/Legends|training grounds]] where [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] was instructing [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]]. Sinube ignited his [[Tera Sinube's sabercane|sabercane]] to defend the younglings and assist Skywalker. As the Temple Guards closed in, Skywalker disarmed Offee of one lightsaber by grabbing her right arm and squeezing it. After another round of clashing blades, Anakin used telekinesis to slam and pin her to a tree, defeating her.

==Aftermath==
[[File:BarrissInCourt-TWJ.png|thumb|left|250px|Offee brought before the court under Temple Guard]]
Offee was then taken to the [[Republic military base]] and was forced to confess at Tano's trial, claiming that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had lost its way, and the [[Trial of Ahsoka Tano/Legends|charges]] against Tano were dropped.

Although Tano was relieved, it was clear the whole ordeal had scarred her. The Council apologized for their actions and asked Ahsoka to rejoin the Order, but to everyone's shock, particularly Anakin's, she refused and left both the Temple and the Order.<ref name="TWJ" />
